entry.title: MBDA wins French order for 40 counter-drone systems
entry.summary: The French defence procurement agency DGA has ordered 40 counter-drone systems from MBDA for the French Ministry of the Armed Forces.
entry.content:
The French defence procurement agency DGA has ordered 40 counter-drone systems from MBDA for the French Ministry of the Armed Forces.

The mobile counter-UAS system combines a radar, electro-optical sensors and interceptors. First deliveries are planned in 2027.

entry.title: MBDA presents hypersonic interceptor concept at European Defence Fund review
entry.summary: MBDA presented its hypersonic interceptor concept to European Defence Fund reviewers, as part of the European study on defence against hypersonic glide vehicles.
entry.content:
MBDA presented its hypersonic interceptor concept to European Defence Fund reviewers, as part of the European study on defence against hypersonic glide vehicles.

The interceptor work covers guidance, propulsion and seeker technologies.
